sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when a value is absent — the act of substituting something for nothing.
The sealed class hierarchy with 'when' exhaustive matching — the compiler forces you to handle every possibility, including the one you want to ignore.
A descriptor's __set_name__ is called once when the class is created, permanently binding a name to the attribute — a name given at birth that the object itself never chose.
